title: Measuring the Explanatory Completeness of Monitoring Reports: What Information Do Incident Responders Actually Need?

original_idea.body: Interview 15-20 security professionals about incident response needs, map to current monitoring outputs, identify gaps.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: User needs analysis is useful but doesn't guarantee design improvements

accessible_complexity.reasoning: User interviews are doable but need careful design

narrow_scope.reasoning: User interviews with 15-20 people is sustained effort
